name: guarana-launcher
description: Guarana Launcher: Windows installer, first-run setup, launcher, updater and doctor (Tauri 2). The web UI is in ui/, the Rust backend in src-tauri/.

scripts.ui:install: npm --prefix ui ci || npm --prefix ui install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.ui:build: npm run ui:install && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.ui:dev: npm run ui:install && npm --prefix ui run dev
scripts.icons: node src-tauri/scripts/render-icon.mjs ../assets/brand/logo-mark.svg src-tauri/target/icon-source-1024.png && tauri icon src-tauri/target/icon-source-1024.png -o src-tauri/icons
